resolver_error_cases.rationale: Empty query text is invalid input and fails before any runtime resolver exists.
Malformed context_ids are rejected deterministically by static contract checks.
Missing fixture artifact fails closed instead of generating a resolver result.
Default exported API blocks /v2/resolve* unless the scoped default-off runtime flag is explicitly enabled.
Deterministic no result returns none semantics without source synthesis.
